title: Spinach and Onion Tortilla Bake
blurb: A simple egg bake with spinach and onions layered between wheat tortillas, lightly spiced with nutmeg.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C. Peel and slice the onion into thin rounds.
Heat the olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat and cook the onion rounds for 5 minutes until softened. Add the spinach and cook for 2 minutes until wilted, then remove from the heat.
Beat the eggs in a bowl with the nutmeg, salt and pepper.
Place one tortilla in the base of a greased 20cm round baking dish or cake tin. Spread half the spinach mixture over it, then pour over half the beaten egg.
Lay the second tortilla on top, add the remaining spinach mixture, then pour over the rest of the egg.
Bake for 20 minutes until the egg is set and the top is lightly golden. Leave to stand for 2 minutes, then cut into rounds to serve.
